title: How To Answer "Tell Me About Yourself" Interview Question | For Students & Professionals
description:
Why is it, that when we are in an interview and someone asks "tell me a bit about yourself?"... we suddenly forget who we are and freeze.... or worse, we ramble? Today, I give you the most helpful interview hack to help you answer the dreaded "Tell me about yourself" interview question. We also will walk through examples on how to answer this question, no matter your experience level!
